title: Freeze, Unfreeze, Close in One Tap
objectives: Learn when and how to freeze your card to instantly pause spending if you see a suspicious charge or misplace your card
Understand how unfreeze instantly resumes your card for normal use when you find your card or confirm charges are safe
Know when to permanently close your card and why it is the right choice for a lost, stolen, or compromised card you will not use again

analogy.title: TV Pause Button vs Unplug
analogy.text: Think of your card like your TV. Freeze is hitting pause – the picture stops but everything is still plugged in and ready to play again instantly when you press play. Unfreeze is pressing play again – your shows and subscriptions continue where you left off. Close is unplugging the TV and recycling it – it will never turn on again and you would need a brand new TV. Just like you would pause the TV when kids are fighting over the remote, freeze your card when something looks suspicious.

pitch30Seconds: Lost your card or see a charge you do not recognize? Do not worry. With one tap you can freeze your card and instantly pause all spending while you check what happened. Found your card in your pocket? Tap unfreeze and it works again right away, no waiting for a new card. If your card is truly lost, stolen, or you want to end it for good, close it permanently. You stay in control, anytime, anywhere.
keyPoints: Freeze instantly pauses all new spending on your card while keeping the card ready to restore
Unfreeze instantly resumes your card so payments and purchases work normally again
Close permanently ends your card — it cannot be reopened and you will need a new card if needed
Use Freeze right away if you see a suspicious charge, lose your card, or need time to check

recallQuiz.question: You notice an unfamiliar charge and cannot find your card. What should you do first?
options: Freeze your card immediately to pause spending
Close your card permanently without checking
Ignore the charge and wait a week
Share your card number to verify the charge
recallQuiz.explanation: Freeze instantly pauses spending so you have time to check if the charge is fraud or just a misplaced card.

recallQuiz.question: What does Unfreeze do?
options: It resumes your card so it works normally again right away
It permanently closes your card forever
It freezes your card automatically for 30 days
It requires you to order a new card to pay again
recallQuiz.explanation: Unfreeze instantly resumes your card so you can spend normally without needing a replacement.

recallQuiz.question: When is it right to choose Close instead of Freeze?
options: When your card is permanently lost, stolen, or compromised and you will not use it again
When you want to pause spending for a few hours while you look for your card
When you see one charge you want to double-check
When you want to temporarily stop online subscriptions
recallQuiz.explanation: Close permanently ends the card and cannot be undone, so use it only when you are sure you need a new card.

testModeNote: Controls act instantly on sample cards, no real money is involved.
